square.start_rule: From prior square SR audits in registered stream/chain order: first 8 chains with mean E/N<-0.4 and first 8 with mean E/N>0, use their last configurations. These deliberately biased starts are diagnostics, not Born samples. Add 8 new uniform fixed-Sz states per seed. Same cold starts for both kernels and parameter states.
square.sampling_interpretation: Compare cold beta=1 cohorts only, retain time trajectories and all chains. Each block matches 384x24 proposal amplitude evaluations (PT:64x6x24); PT refresh and swap overhead are separately counted. Cohort agreement is necessary not sufficient for equilibrium. With persistent disagreement, report energy as unresolved; do not average biased cohorts into a production energy.
square.diagnostic_reference: Evaluate identical saved starts under both frozen parameter states and independently replay 6 fixed full-H ratios by vectorized explicit exchanged configurations. No parameter interpolation, optimizer update, new ED or candidate search.

scope: Same 4032-parameter fixed-Sz exact-lattice-A1 architecture. Triangular replication varies training sampling randomness at the SAME inherited step-1064 checkpoint, not independent weight initialization. Original optimizer policies unchanged. Audits have 48 chains/1536 records per endpoint (half previous count); do not pretend identical audit precision. Two new seeds x energy/variance form four primary tests, with 98.75% Bonferroni intervals. No pooling away a failed seed. Square parameters remain byte-identical throughout; this is a frozen sampler intervention, not more training.
budget: Triangular: 4x8192 training +4x1536 audit +2x64 warm=39040 full-H calls. Square: 2 states x2 seeds x2 kernels x25 snapshots x24 chains=4800 calls; plus 2x24 fixed-start calls and 2x6 independent explicit replays=60. Total planned full-H centers=43900. Square each job has 221184 proposal amplitude evaluations plus refreshes; no adaptive extension. Local CPU only, estimated 30-40 minutes plus validation.
